title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Predaplant Chimerafflesia Legendary Duelists: Season 3 LDS3-EN074
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: This Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card features the Predaplant Chimerafflesia, with 2500 attack and 2000 defense. It is a fusion card, with Ultra Rare rarity and 1st Edition feature. The card number is LDS3-EN074, and it is in English language. Manufactured by Konami, this card is perfect for collectors and players of the Yu-Gi-Oh! Trading Card Game.
